gloss: to sidle up to; to cozy up to; to ingratiate oneself

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {摺|す}り{寄|よ}りませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {摺|す}り{寄|よ}っていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {摺|す}り{寄|よ}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to sidle up to; to edge closer
definitions.explanation: To move close to someone by shuffling or sliding, often stealthily.

definitions.gloss: to cozy up to; to ingratiate oneself
definitions.explanation: To try to gain favor with someone, often opportunistically.

examples.english: The cat sidled up to my legs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{母親|ははおや}→母親：03564_hahaoya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{摺|す}り{寄|よ}った。
examples.english: The child snuggled up to their mother.

examples.japanese: ⟦{権力者|けんりょくしゃ}→権力者：17021_kenryokusha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{摺|す}り{寄|よ}る⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many people try to cozy up to those in power.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出世|しゅっせ}→出世：08359_shusse⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧とたん、⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{摺|す}り{寄|よ}ってきた。
examples.english: As soon as he was promoted, people started cozying up to him.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{摺|す}り{寄|よ}った。
examples.english: Saying I was cold, I sidled up to her.

examples.japanese: ⟦{金持|かねも}ち→金持ち：02993_kanemochi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{摺|す}り{寄|よ}る⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{見苦|みぐる}しい→見苦しい：23219_migurushii⟧。
examples.english: Cozying up to rich people is unseemly.

notes:
WRITING:
Often written in hiragana as すり{寄|よ}る or すりよる. The kanji {摺|す} is less common.

TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧). Takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ for the person/thing one sidles up to.

USAGE:
In sense 2, the word often implies opportunism or insincerity - trying to gain favor for selfish reasons.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {摺|す}り{寄|よ}る - to sidle up (can be neutral or negative)
- ⟦{近|ちか}づく→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧ - to approach (neutral)
- ⟦{甘|あま}える→甘える：06624_amaeru⟧ - to be affectionate, dependent (positive nuance)
- {取|と}り{入|い}る - to ingratiate oneself (clearly negative)
